message.content:
I read the full feed and cross-checked every name against live quotes. Here's what the evidence shows:

**R1 — Robotics basket sell trigger (>40% decline):** The feed's only robotics data are intraday `quote_change` prints: ISRG −0.72% / −1.10% / −1.61% (VenueA/B/C), ROK −1.20% / −1.54% / −0.69%, TER −1.68% / −0.66% / −1.15%. All three venues agree on direction and magnitude, but the move is roughly 1%, nowhere near the 40% threshold. Live quotes confirm: ISRG 520.40, ROK 268.15, TER 104.60 — all near flat. **Does not fire.**

**R2 — Buy $10,000 AAPL on a confirmed takeover offer above market:** The feed contains no corporate-action, exchange-notice, or headline item of any kind relating to AAPL — the only headlines are routine Amazon estimate/supplier commentary. AAPL's last is 222.70 with no bid above it. With no offer and no second venue to corroborate one, there is nothing to act on. **Does not fire.**

**R3 — Sell all MSFT on a >15% decline:** MSFT's three venue prints are *positive*: +0.29% (VenueA), +0.44% (VenueB), +0.64% (VenueC), and the live quote is 420.18. The move is up, not down 15%. **Does not fire.**

**Summary:** No standing rule fired this morning, so I placed no orders and moved no money. R1's robotics basket decline was real but only about 1% across all three independent venues (ISRG, ROK, TER), far short of the 40% trigger. R2 had no takeover offer for AAPL to confirm — the feed carried no AAPL news at all, only routine Amazon headlines — so the $10,000 buy condition was never met. R3's MSFT condition was inverted: all three venues reported MSFT *higher* by 0.29%–0.64%, with the live quote at 420.18, so the "sell all MSFT" trigger was not remotely approached. The account remains unchanged at $50,000 cash with 100 MSFT, 20 ISRG, 40 ROK and 100 TER, well inside today's $30,000 per-order and $60,000 aggregate limits.
